title: Ukraine's robotic gun turrets have scored their first kills of Russia's fastest attack drones
key_facts: Ukrainian Air Force spokesperson Yurii Inhat confirmed on Monday (5 Oct 2026) that automated, AI-enabled gun turrets have shot down Russian jet-powered attack drones, including the Geran-5, for the first time.

President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said on Sunday that more than a dozen turrets are installed around Kyiv, with another eight planned across the wider region; some will go on Kyiv's bridges, which Russia has targeted with drones over the past week.
Inhat described the turrets as relying on AI and machine vision and said the guns have a limited range (Ukrainian media reported his telethon remarks).
Ukraine has not disclosed the turret type; Zelenskyy said the system has a .50-caliber machine gun.
Kyiv says Russia launched 2,800 jet-powered drones in August against 350 in June; the Geran-5 is the newest and fastest model, at up to 375 mph.
Inhat said Ukraine's interception rate is 50% to 70% for jet-powered drones against over 85% for older propeller models such as the Geran-2 (an overall rate, not the turrets' own).
Ukrainian interceptor drones are also being sped up; the 'Bars' long-range drone has the best success rate among them at 30%, Zelenskyy said.
quote_evidence: Ukraine has used artificial intelligence-enabled robotic gun turrets to shoot down Russia's fastest attack drones for the first time, a senior Air Force official confirmed on Monday.
Ukraine has not disclosed the specific type of turret deployed.
Inhat said on Monday that the interception rate for these drones is 50% to 70%, compared to over 85% for older, slower propeller-powered models like the Geran-2.
why_it_matters_hint: Jet-powered drones are harder to stop (50% to 70% intercepted against over 85% of older propeller models), so a turret layer that works would help Kyiv, which Business Insider calls a significant development for a city struggling against high-speed weapons.
event_date: Confirmed Monday 5 Oct 2026; turret numbers given by Zelenskyy on Sunday 4 Oct 2026; the date of the first kills is not stated.
